clips.title: Definition of ready vs Definition of done
clips.why: A short, concrete example of a definition of done: a list everyone agrees on before work starts, so "done" means the same to the builder and the reviewer.
look: The definition of done is agreed before the work, not argued about after it.
Each item can be checked by someone else, which is what makes it useful.
clips.after: plan-and-grill writes this per ticket: one or two sentences of done, then labelled checks, each with the proof that will show it.

clips.title: Pull Request Tips your Team will THANK YOU For (Best Practices)
clips.why: A frontend developer explains what a reviewer needs from a pull request description: context, screenshots or recordings, and a small change.
look: Context first: why the change exists and what it does, before any detail.
Screenshots and recordings for visual changes, so the reviewer does not have to run the branch.
Short pull requests, because a reviewer's attention runs out.
clips.after: pr-story turns these tips into fixed headings in a fixed order, and ties each screenshot or video to a check from the plan.

practice.q: Put pr-story's headings in their fixed order.
items: What was not checked, and why
practice.why: The order follows the reviewer's questions: what, why, was it proven, what was skipped, what could go wrong, where to start reading.

practice.q: Complete the pull request title for the frontend ticket RH-1234.
practice.after: RH-1234: Empty projects table shows a No projects yet card
practice.hint: The area in square brackets: FE or BE.
practice.why: The title says the area, the ticket, and what changes for the user, so a list of pull requests reads like a list of changes.

practice.q: A check is about the layout of the new card. Which proof does the plan ask for?

options.text: A 30-second video of the whole app
options.why: A video fits a flow, where something moves. A layout is about widths, and a long video hides them.
Those are the narrowest and widest widths we support, so two pictures show the layout holds across the range.

options.text: A picture of the component's code
options.why: Pictures of code cannot be searched or copied, and they show the code, not what the user sees.

practice.q: A pull request only renames internal functions and changes nothing a user can see. What media does pr-story add?

options.text: Nothing, and the description says there is no visible change
options.why: Proof should match the change. A refactor's proof is the test run, written as text.

options.text: Before and after screenshots, to be safe
options.why: Two identical pictures cost the reviewer time and prove nothing a test run does not.

options.text: A diagram of every renamed function
options.why: A diagram fits a changed flow between services. A rename has no new flow.
